purpose: V2-P02 §9-§14 — per-entity live mapping evidence. NOT_EXERCISED because no live server is reachable. Static (code-level) evidence for two identified gates is recorded below so remediation can be planned before V2-P02 is re-run.

SQL_IDENTIFIER_GATE.current_behaviour_summary: When CatalogTable.sql_identifier is None, GroundingContextBuilder skips the table and appends a GroundingIssue(code='unresolved_sql_identifier'). The table does NOT enter the final GroundingContext and no fallback identifier is derived from table_name / FQN.
SQL_IDENTIFIER_GATE.verdict_from_static_analysis: SAFE — fail-closed; UNKNOWN identifiers do not enter S0 context.
SQL_IDENTIFIER_GATE.OpenMetadata_mapper_behaviour: table_mapper._build_sql_identifier (src/t2s/integrations/openmetadata/table_mapper.py:187-196) returns sql_identifier from raw.sqlIdentifier or raw.extension.sqlIdentifier; otherwise returns (None, 'unresolved'). No guess is made.
SQL_IDENTIFIER_GATE.live_verification_needed: For each pilot table, record SQL_IDENTIFIER_STATUS. If any required pilot table is UNRESOLVED, classify SQL_IDENTIFIER_MAPPING_GAP and decide between (A) OpenMetadata legitimately contains the identifier but the mapper failed to read it, or (B) company metadata simply does not carry it. V2-P02 §10 forbids inventing a fallback.

NULLABILITY_SEMANTICS_GATE.verbatim_snippet: is_nullable=column.is_nullable if column.is_nullable is not None else True
NULLABILITY_SEMANTICS_GATE.current_behaviour_summary: GroundingContextBuilder materializes CatalogColumn.is_nullable=None as ColumnContext.is_nullable=True when building the TableContext. The S0 serializer (DirectSqlPromptBuilder._format_authorized_schema) then emits 'nullable: True' verbatim into the solver prompt.
NULLABILITY_SEMANTICS_GATE.verdict_from_static_analysis: UNKNOWN → FACTUAL TRUE conversion PRESENT in code. This violates the project's 'UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN' principle (Doc 04 §19).
NULLABILITY_SEMANTICS_GATE.OpenMetadata_mapper_behaviour: column_mapper._map_nullable (src/t2s/integrations/openmetadata/column_mapper.py:38-44) returns None (UNKNOWN) when isNullable is absent and constraint is not NOT_NULL/PRIMARY_KEY. So OpenMetadata correctly preserves UNKNOWN at the canonical DTO layer; the loss of UNKNOWN happens later, at ColumnContext construction.
NULLABILITY_SEMANTICS_GATE.impact_on_pilot: Any pilot column whose OM entity omits isNullable AND does not carry NOT_NULL/PRIMARY_KEY constraint would silently reach the solver prompt as 'nullable: True'.
NULLABILITY_SEMANTICS_GATE.live_verification_needed: Count columns_nullable_unknown on the actual pilot. If > 0, NULLABILITY_SEMANTICS_GAP = DETECTED and semantic metadata fidelity CANNOT be certified for those columns.
remediation_options_documented_not_imple: Option 1: Change ColumnContext to accept is_nullable=None and change the S0 serializer to emit 'nullable: unknown' instead of 'True'. This is a semantics change to MG0 representation and must be proposed with an isolated impact analysis (V2-P02 §11 forbids preemptive fix).
Option 2: Reject columns with UNKNOWN nullability at MG0 boundary (fail-closed). This may drop too many columns in real enterprise catalogs.
Option 3: Add a provenance flag 'is_nullable_source' ∈ {declared, inferred, unknown} to ColumnContext; keep is_nullable=True but let the serializer show the provenance. Least invasive.
Any option requires a separate governance phase; V2-P02 does not implement it.
NULLABILITY_SEMANTICS_GATE.policy_for_v2_p02: Documented as a KNOWN CODE-LEVEL GAP. Does not automatically block V2-P02, because the current phase is BLOCKED by environment absence. When the live pilot runs, NULLABILITY_SEMANTICS_GAP = DETECTED will be recorded for pilot columns lacking nullability declarations; those columns will not receive semantic-fidelity certification, but the pilot itself may still pass if the identity/FQN/column mapping/PK-FK/authorization gates hold.
